2. Text on video. One idea, big words, stock clips underneath.

3. AI voiceover list. Quick, ranked, easy to script.

Pick one. Make ten at a time in one sitting. Keep every post looking the same so people know it's you. Change one thing at a time, or you won't know what worked.
